meta.evidence_status: simulation and calculation (hand-pen-paper model H1, synthetic handwriting and tremor; nothing measured)

hand.k_nib: config/parameters.yaml hand.grip_stiffness 575 N/m (230-1040): tip-referred in-plane grasp stiffness k1
hand.measurement_point: Fu & Cavusoglu 2012 Sec. II-B: force applied and position recorded at the stylus gimbal centre; grip-force sensor 4 cm from it -> the lumped model is a driving-point impedance about 4 cm ahead of the fingers, taken here as the nib
hand.normal: the grip is made isotropic at the nib (575 N/m, 1.3 N s/m in x, y and z); parameters.yaml assumes 800 N/m, 3 N s/m normal (range 200-3000); the P1 comparison is run with the same normal values
grip.z_f: finger pads (thumb, index, middle) centred 27.5 mm from the nib (20-35 mm)
grip.z_w: thumb-index web contact centred 75 mm from the nib (60-90 mm)
grip.r_rot: fraction of the nib's static grip compliance that comes from pen rotation relative to the hand (0 = the pen cannot tilt in the grip, 1 = pure pivot); nominal 0.5, swept 0.1-0.8; measure with EXP-I01 (two-point compliance)
grip.rho_w: share of the translational grip stiffness carried at the web (0.3; swept 0.1-0.6); EXP-I01
pad.k: index fingertip tangential stiffness 0.6-2.0 kN/m, damping 0.75-2.38 N s/m at 0.5 N normal force (7 participants); k = 1.48 n^0.35 N/mm, b = 1.78 n^0.35 N s/m with n the normal force in N (author's copy, Table 1-2)
contact.k_sk: skid-paper contact 1e5 N/m, 10 N s/m (model P1 values, EXP-Q01)
contact.F_c: nib spring 0.15 N axial -> ball normal force F_c/sin(theta) = 0.196 N at 50 deg (EXP-Q02)
budget: config/pencil.yaml envelope, battery (90 mAh, 0.266 Wh usable), electronics 65 mW
rho_WHA: Elmet ASTM B777 class 3 (95 % W): 18 g/cm3; ET95NM non-magnetic (permeability <= 1.05)
motor.0308B: Faulhaber 0308 H 003 B: 3 x 8 mm, 0.35 g, 61 000 rpm no-load at 3 V, I0 27 mA, stall 0.026 mNm, rated 0.013 mNm, friction 1.77e-3 mNm + 1.09e-7 mNm/rpm, 96 000 rpm max, ruby bearings, eta 20 %
motor.0515B: Faulhaber 0515 G 006 B: 5 x 15 mm, 1.6 g, 43 000 rpm no-load at 6 V, I0 56 mA, stall 0.4 mNm, rated 0.084 mNm, k_M 1.15 mNm/A, R 16.1 ohm, friction 0.033 mNm + 6.5e-7 mNm/rpm, 77 000 rpm max, sintered bearings
balance: rotor balance grade G2.5 (G0.4-G6.3); secondary summaries of ISO 21940-11 list G0.4 for gyroscopes; not verified against the standard
wrist.k: passive wrist stiffness matrix mean [1.28 -0.18; -0.18 1.74] N m/rad (FE, RUD), flexion 0.55, extension 1.02 N m/rad (Formica et al. 2012, 10 subjects, relaxed)
wrist.J: hand inertia about the wrist 2-4.5e-3 kg m^2 (0.4-0.5 kg hand, CoM 60-80 mm from the wrist)
vcm.Km: reaction-mass voice coil K_m 0.06 N/sqrt(W) for a tungsten slug with a moving magnet, 0.04 N/sqrt(W) for coils around the moving cell; scaled from stage_vcm.Km 0.080 N/sqrt(W) (magpylib, pencil.yaml)
pen.body: results/cad/pencil_revPQ_summary.json parts (12.2 g, CoM 88 mm) x1.10 for wiring/adhesive (model P1 convention); own-length inertia of barrel, cell, board, plates and refill as uniform rods

protocol.reference: same pen (device neutral) on the same handwriting without tremor (harness convention of model P1)
protocol.ratio: e_rms(controller or device, tremor) / e_rms(no correction, tremor), both against that reference
protocol.oracle: stage: cancels the true ball deviation from the clean path (P1 oracle); reaction mass / CMG: iterative learning on the true disturbance with projection onto the device limits, best of 4 projection settings
protocol.passive: ratio_own = tremor error against the same pen's clean ink / unmodified; ratio_total = against the unmodified pen's clean ink; distortion = clean ink of the variant vs the unmodified pen
protocol.tremor: trans: hand-path TremorSpec (P1); rot_yaw: hand-frame rotation about the page normal through a wrist pivot L_p behind the grip, 0.3 mm peak at the nib; mixed: both at 0.21 mm
protocol.grip_split: nominal r_rot 0.5, rho_w 0.3 (ASSUMPTION); swept in split_sensitivity

calibration.label: CALCULATION: massless-pen driving-point compliance of the calibrated grip against HAP-26 eq. (1)

notes.method: single-frequency oracle bound on the frictionless linear model: each input phased optimally, |input| <= min(force limit, stroke / |stroke per unit force|) for a reaction mass, 2 H min(rate_max, w delta_max) for a CMG pair, motor torque for wheels; passive devices: ratio of nib amplitudes with and without the device
notes.tremor: 0.3 mm hand-path ellipse (TremorSpec major axis 0.6 rad, ellipticity 0.4) or 0.3 mm at the nib from a wrist yaw rotation about a pivot 175 mm behind the grip
notes.label: CALCULATION (linear model; optimistic: no friction, no amplitude modulation)

size_for_50pct.label: CALCULATION (frictionless linear model, single frequency, optimal phase: a lower bound on the size needed)

rm_cell.label: Active reaction mass: the cell (3.45 g, +/-0.5 mm, 2 axes)

gyro_30k.label: Passive gyroscope: 3.82 g tungsten rotor at 30 krpm (H 79 uN m s)
gyro_30k.note_vibration: pen-body vibration at the spin frequency; the ink moves the same sub-micron amount (invisible); HAP-27 reports 0.06 um thresholds near 320 Hz, so it is likely felt as a buzz and heard as a tone

cmg_lat.label: CMG scissored pair x1: rotors 1.58 g at 60 krpm (H 40 uN m s each), gimbal +/-0.6 rad, 30 rad/s

cmg_2ax.label: CMG scissored pair x2: rotors 1.58 g at 60 krpm (H 40 uN m s each), gimbal +/-0.6 rad, 30 rad/s
cmg_2ax.note_vibration: pen-body vibration at the spin frequency; the ink moves the same sub-micron amount (invisible); HAP-27 reports 0.06 um thresholds near 320 Hz, so it is likely felt as a buzz and heard as a tone

wheels_2ax.label: Reaction wheels (2 axes): tungsten ring 7/2 x 6 mm on a 5 mm BLDC each (AMF-51)
wheels_2ax.fits: no: two 25 mm modules exceed the 40 mm cell space

sleeve.label: Active grip sleeve: pen body pivots at the finger pads (z 27.5 mm) inside a finger sleeve; 2-axis actuator ring at the web end (z 75 mm)
sleeve.note: the sleeve moves the whole barrel, so the paper's transverse reaction N cos(theta) + friction (0.74 N at 1 N, 50 deg) passes through its actuators; the nib stage behind the skid holds 0.17 N. K_m is the Rev A coil (0.717 N/A over sqrt(6 ohm), parameters.yaml), which needs a 15 mm grip

oracle_method_check.note: time-domain oracle vs the frictionless linear bound, seed 200: pure sine vs TremorSpec default, with and without paper friction

viscous_3.label: Viscous nose 3 N s/m (idealised damped roller)

grip_visco_x0.5.label: Viscoelastic sleeve: x0.5 stiffness, +3 N s/m
